new_today_news.headline: Darling Ingredients earnings on deck amid renewable fuel boom
new_today_news.summary: With Q2 2026 earnings approaching, analysts debate whether Diamond Green Diesel's equity value has been fully reflected in Darling's stock price. Focus on RIN pricing and potential regulatory headwinds from additional small refinery exemptions.

new_today_news.headline: Clean Harbors Expands Field Services Through Planned $305 Million Acquisition of ES&H
new_today_news.summary: Clean Harbors announced a planned $305 million acquisition of ES&H to expand its field services capabilities. The acquisition is part of the company's strategic growth initiatives in the environmental services sector.

new_today_news.headline: Clean Harbors Safety-Kleen Unit Reports 41% Revenue Growth, 143% Adjusted EBITDA Surge; Collects 61 Million Gallons of Waste Oil in Q2
new_today_news.summary: Clean Harbors' Safety-Kleen Sustainability Solutions (SKSS) segment, which handles used oil collection and re-refined products, posted exceptional Q2 results with 41% revenue growth and 143% EBITDA growth. The segment collected 61 million gallons of waste oil and benefited from stronger re-refined product pricing.

recent_news.headline: Transfer Station Tipping Fee Increase Effective September 1, 2026
recent_news.summary: Transfer station announces tipping fee increases of $80.00 per ton for household, commercial, and industrial waste, effective September 1, 2026.

recent_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Builds a Stronger Core Beyond Renewable Fuels
recent_news.summary: Darling Ingredients' Diamond Green Diesel joint venture recovered sharply in Q1 2026, with EBITDA contribution rising to $151.2 million. The company is strengthening its core rendering and ingredients business while maintaining renewable diesel as a growth driver amid improving RIN economics.

backfill_news.headline: Florida Grease Trap Regulations 2026: FOG Rules & City Fines
backfill_news.summary: Summary of Florida's FOG compliance requirements for commercial kitchens including installation, maintenance, manifest tracking, and disposal facility certification under updated state regulations.

backfill_news.headline: Grease Trap Installation Cost 2026: $500–$20,000 by Trap Type
backfill_news.summary: Updated cost analysis for grease trap installation ranges from $2,000 to $20,000+ depending on size and placement. Small indoor traps cost $2,000–$5,000 while large outdoor interceptors cost $7,000–$15,000+ with excavation and permits included.
